sn43.1:2.1: Iti kho bhikkhave desitaṃ vo mayā asaṅkhatam desito asaṅkhatagāmi maggo || || 5
sn43.1:2.2: Yam bhikkhave satthārā karaṇīyaṃ sāvakānaṃ hitesinā anukampena anukampam upādāya kataṃ vo taṃ mayā || || 6
sn43.1:2.3: Etāni bhikkhave rukkhamūlāni etāni suññāgārāni jhāyatha mā pamādattha mā pacchāvippaṭisārino ahuvattha || || Ayaṃ kho vo amhākam anusāsanīti || || 1
